description: Canvas swapchain configure capabilities: the one source that TS buildCanvasConfigureOptions() and the WASM path (JS_CreateSurfaceFromCanvas, JS_ProbeCanvasCopySrc, ConfigureSurface() in device.cpp) both read. TS imports this JSON; C++ includes wasm_renderer/canvas_configure.h, generated from it by `npm run gen:canvas-configure` (verify:device-policy fails when the header is stale or device.cpp hardcodes a contracted value). WASM keeps BOTH configures: JS (opaque + usage) then C++ (width/height + Fifo). Format is navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat() except under optIn.hdrCanvas (TS only). colorSpace/toneMapping defaults are the browser defaults and are not written explicitly on the default path. Each optIn entry is one capability; its `backends` lists the renderers that implement it, and the WASM configure may only touch keys of capabilities that list "wasm". `requires` names a capability that must also be on. v4 (#1512): hdrCanvas, storageBinding, hdrToneMap.

copySrc.note: Boot probe tries RENDER_ATTACHMENT|COPY_SRC inside a validation error scope, records the result, then restores render-only. Capture code reconfigures with copySrc only when the flag is true, and restores render-only when the take ends. Both backends: TS probeCanvasCopySrc (window.webgpuProbe.canvasCopySrc) and C++ JS_ProbeCanvasCopySrc (window.webgpuProbe with backend: wasm). No second GPUDevice.

displayP3.note: Never requested at boot by default. Enabled by ?display_p3=1 (wins) or the persisted Render quality toggle (localStorage storageKey). Fail-soft to srgb when the browser rejects it or getConfiguration() reports a different colorSpace.

extendedToneMapping.note: Only behind the display-p3 opt-in and only on an HDR display.

hdrCanvas.note: Real HDR output (#1512): with extended tone mapping the swapchain is rgba16float (an 8-bit swapchain clamps to [0,1], so 'extended' alone shows nothing). Negotiated together with displayP3 + extendedToneMapping; the present pipeline is re-specialised for the format and applies the hdrToneMap tonemap. Falls back to the preferred format (p3 + standard) when rejected.

storageBinding.note: Direct-to-swapchain present (#1512): when the device has bgra8unorm-storage and the preferred format is bgra8unorm, the boot probe tries RENDER_ATTACHMENT|STORAGE_BINDING in a validation scope. When accepted, an eligible final slot writes the swapchain texture as storage and the present blit is skipped (webgpu/directPresent.ts). Kept on the live configure while accepted; copySrc / color renegotiation preserve it.

hdrToneMap.note: Canvas 1.0 is the display's SDR white, taken as the BT.2408 reference white. The HDR present maps working linear x to canvas exposure·x below 1.0 with a soft shoulder toward headroom = peak / sdrReferenceWhite. Project files carry it as render.hdr.

copySrc.note: Probe runs once in CreateDevice() between wgpuDevicePushErrorScope(Validation) and wgpuDevicePopErrorScope, then ConfigureSurface() restores render-only. ConfigureSurface() adds the opt-in bits only when canvasCopySrc_ is set, and only SetCanvasCopySrc() assigns it. colorSpace/toneMapping stay TS-only (optIn.displayP3 / extendedToneMapping backends).
